calls.title: Chris <> Wellhub Monthly Sync
calls.summary: The team discussed the migration from Groovebook's current server setup to a new proxy-based architecture aimed at supporting remote evaluation across client-side applications. This transition involves issuing new SDK keys for client-side apps, ensuring backward compatibility while retiring older API features. Cache configuration discrepancies were addressed, with a default 30-second TTL for the new proxy being mitigated by leveraging the CDN’s policies. SLO tracking will rely on HTTP request traces during early migration phases. The shift to remote evaluation is framed as critical for enhanced data security, while feedback indicates strong internal support for the new proxy setup among developers.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook proxy, remote evaluation, SDK keys, CDN cache, API endpoints, data leak mitigation
